The **ESPGHAN 2025 UC guideline** refers specifically to the European Society for Paediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition's (ESPGHAN) updated 2025 clinical guideline for ulcerative colitis in children [^src1]. It is distinct from earlier versions of the guideline and should not be confused with ESPGHAN's guidelines for Crohn's disease [^src1].

This guideline serves as the international evidence base that directly prompted a revision of [[indikator-1b|Indikator 1b]] within the Danish IBD quality improvement framework (DANIBD) [^src1]. Specifically, the 2025 update no longer recommends routine small bowel evaluation for all newly diagnosed pediatric patients [^src1]. As a result, the requirements for Indikator 1b were adjusted from demanding three specific examinations down to two, reflecting this shift in international clinical consensus [^src1]. 

The publication of this guideline in 2025 marks a significant moment in Danish healthcare quality development, illustrating how DANIBD uses up-to-date international data to drive evidence-based practice changes and adjust clinical quality indicators for inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) in children and adolescents [^src1].
